# Annual navigation

This release creates **2,326 annual Markdown files**, from 300 BCE through 2026 CE, with no year zero. The starting boundary is editorial, not proof that writing began in 300 BCE.

[Browse BCE](BCE/README.md) · [Browse CE](CE/README.md) · [Era and period dossiers](../periods/README.md)

Most annual pages are unresearched navigation placeholders. A period link is not a year-specific event. See [coverage](../coverage/README.md).
